item.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'pwd; cat TASK.md; cat solution.py; cat test_public.py'

/bin/zsh -lc "python3.12 - <<'PY'
from solution import load_people
h = 'name,email,age,active\\n'
valid = [
 ('\\ufeff active , age , email , name \\r\\nFALSE,130,A@B,\"Doe, Jo\"\\r\\n', [{'name':'Doe, Jo','email':'a@b','age':130,'active':False}]),
 (h + '\"A\\nB\",A@B,000,TrUe\\n', [{'name':'A\\nB','email':'a@b','age':0,'active':True}]),
 (h + '\\n , , \\n,,,,,\\n\"A\"\"B\",a@b,,\\n', [{'name':'A\"B','email':'a@b','age':None,'active':False}]),
 (h + 'A,a@b,' + '0'*5000 + '1,0', [{'name':'A','email':'a@b','age':1,'active':False}]),
 (h, []),
]
for text, expected in valid:
 assert load_people(text) == expected
invalid = ['', '\\n'+h, 'name,email,age,name\\n', 'name,email,age,active,x\\n', h+'A,a@b,1', h+'A,a@b,1,true,x', h+',a@b,1,1', h+'A,a@@b,1,1', h+'A,@b,1,1', h+'A,a@,1,1', h+'A,a @b,1,1', h+'A,a@b,131,1', h+'A,a@b,-1,1', h+'A,a@b,+1,1', h+'A,a@b,1.0,1', h+'A,a@b,١,1', h+'A,a@b,1,yes', h+'\"A,a@b,1,1', h+'A\"B,a@b,1,1', h+'\"A\"x,a@b,1,1', h+'A,a@b,1,1\\nB,b@c,999,1']
for text in invalid:
 try:
  load_people(text)
 except ValueError:
  pass
 else:
  raise AssertionError(repr(text))
print(f'Passed {len(valid)} valid and {len(invalid)} invalid additional cases')
PY
 git diff --check
 git diff --stat"
